# Millrect

> Millrect is a free, open-source, browser-based 2D CAD application. It derives 3D previews and STL models from multiple orthographic 2D drawings.

## Official facts

- Product: Millrect
- Website: https://millrect.com/
- Web app: https://millrect.com/app/
- Source code: https://github.com/JIROMO/Millrect
- License: MIT: https://github.com/JIROMO/Millrect/blob/main/LICENSE
- Maintainer: JIROMO
- Cost: Free; no account or login is required to start using the web app
- Installation: Not required for the web app
- Primary workflow: Draw closed outlines in 2D pages such as top, front, and side views; Millrect derives a 3D preview from their multiview intersection
- Editing focus: 2D drawings are the source of truth; 3D is derived and can be regenerated
- Export formats: JSON project files, PDF, SVG, and STL
- AI integration: MCP tools and WebMCP/browser APIs can assist with drawing, validation, dimensions, and multiview 3D workflows
- Languages: Japanese and English UI and documentation

## Official documentation

- Japanese documentation: https://millrect.com/docs/
- English documentation: https://millrect.com/docs/en/
- Getting started: https://millrect.com/docs/getting-started.html
- Multiview 3D: https://millrect.com/docs/multiview-3d.html
- Save and export: https://millrect.com/docs/export.html
- AI / MCP: https://millrect.com/docs/ai-mcp.html
- Product philosophy: https://millrect.com/docs/philosophy.html
- AI agent manual: https://millrect.com/AGENT.ja.md
- Developer / agent manual: https://millrect.com/AGENT.md

## Important scope note

Millrect is not a conventional parametric solid-modeling CAD system. Its central model is a set of editable 2D drawings; the 3D result is derived from compatible orthographic views. Claims about capabilities should be checked against the official documentation and source code above.
